title.purpose: Only the empty, tracing, and failure titles on the plate.

body.purpose: Helper text, errors, and instructions; wraps at the key measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase section labels, button labels, and status text.

data.purpose: Every value, path, dimension, status code, and mode name.

motion.name: trace-sweep
motion.purpose: Indeterminate progress while a trace is running; no percentage is invented.

motion.name: register-settle
motion.purpose: The registration ticks snap back into register when the plate is ready.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.value: BINVEC_REDUCE_MOTION=1 disables the sweep and the settle
motion.purpose: A reduced-motion path that keeps the textual TRACING/READY state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single confirming action; ink fill with paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #15161A; color: #F3F0E7; border: 1px solid #15161A; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 12px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2B2D33; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #F3F0E7; border-color: #D8D2C3; color: #6E6A60; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Open or alternate action; transparent with an ink hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #15161A; border: 1px solid #15161A; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 12px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F8F5EC; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #E8E3D6; }

components.name: Mode Segment
components.description: BINARY/COLOR and VECTOR/SOURCE switches; the active half is an ink field.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #15161A; border-radius: 2px; background: #F3F0E7; } .ds-segment button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 1px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; color: #15161A; font: 600 12px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-segment button.is-active { background: #15161A; color: #F3F0E7; } .ds-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-swatch-binary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #15161A 50%, #F3F0E7 50%); } .ds-swatch-color { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00A8BE 50%, #E14134 50%); }

components.name: Checked Checkbox
components.description: 16px ink switch used for alpha and inversion.
components.css: .ds-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #15161A; font: 400 12px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-check input { appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1px solid #15161A; border-radius: 1px; background: #F3F0E7; } .ds-check input:checked { background: #15161A; } .ds-check input:checked::after { content: '✓'; display: block; color: #F3F0E7; font: 700 12px/14px system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: Plate Slider
components.description: 2px rail with a teal filled side and an 8px paper handle.
components.css: .ds-slider { appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 16px; background: transparent; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00A8BE 50%, #D8D2C3 50%); } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { appearance: none; width: 8px; height: 16px; margin-top: -7px; background: #F3F0E7; border: 1px solid #15161A; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-track { height: 2px; background: #D8D2C3; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-progress { height: 2px; background: #00A8BE; } .ds-slider::-moz-range-thumb { width: 8px; height: 16px; background: #F3F0E7; border: 1px solid #15161A; border-radius: 1px; }

components.name: Proof Plate
components.description: The ink-framed figure with checkerboard, crop marks, hatching, and registration state.
components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 1px solid #15161A; background-color: #F3F0E7; background-image: conic-gradient(#E8E3D6 25%, transparent 0 50%, #E8E3D6 0 75%, transparent 0); background-size: 32px 32px; } .ds-crop { position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-color: #15161A; border-style: solid; } .ds-crop-tl { left: 12px; top: 12px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; } .ds-crop-tr { right: 12px; top: 12px; border-width: 1px 1px 0 0; } .ds-crop-bl { left: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-width: 0 0 1px 1px; } .ds-crop-br { right: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; } .ds-plate figcaption { position: absolute; left: 24px; top: -24px; color: #6E6A60; font: 600 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Reference Key
components.description: Fixed 304px control column with hairline rules and a scrolling body.
components.css: .ds-key { width: 304px; height: 100%; border-right: 1px solid #D8D2C3; background: #F3F0E7; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-key h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #6E6A60; font: 600 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-key section { padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #D8D2C3; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-key p { margin: 0; color: #15161A; font: 400 13px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Record Strip
components.description: 34px fixed footer with the export path and fit/zoom controls.
components.css: .ds-record { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 34px; padding: 0 24px; border-top: 1px solid #D8D2C3; color: #6E6A60; font: 400 11px/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Theme Control
components.description: Compact AUTO / LIGHT / DARK segment in the title block; Auto follows the OS and the manual choice persists.
components.css: .ds-theme { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:2px; border:1px solid #3B3730; border-radius:2px; background:#171614; } .ds-theme button { border:0; border-radius:1px; padding:4px 8px; background:transparent; color:#F1EBDD; font:600 11px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-theme button.is-active { background:#F1EBDD; color:#171614; }

narrative.overview: BinVec is a proofing table, not a settings form. The drawing owns the window; a narrow reference key names the controls; the plate, crop marks and registration ticks carry the working state. Light mode is a paper table with a paper plate. Dark mode is an ink-room: the chrome goes near-black while the proof plate stays lit paper, so the trace and the source proof keep their contrast. A title-block AUTO / LIGHT / DARK control follows the OS by default and persists an explicit override.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper shell and plate; dark ink-room shell with the same lit plate paper.
One figure per window; controls live in a 304px reference key.
AUTO / LIGHT / DARK control; system-following by default, persisted override.
Registration and proof state, not cards or shadows, communicate progress.
Every value, path, dimension, status and mode name is monospaced.
No shadows, gradients, glass, emoji or icon fonts.

rules.name: The Single-Plot Rule
rules.body: One filled ink swatch and one word name the active mode. A second accent never competes with the drawing.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Teal Rule
rules.body: Bright teal is a fill and a square, never small text. Use deep teal when the accent must be read.

rules.name: The Lit Plate Rule
rules.body: Dark mode darkens the shell, never the proof. The plate remains paper so ink traces and source proofs keep their contrast.

rules.name: The One Scale Rule
rules.body: Labels, values, and captions share one compact size. Hierarchy comes from rules, weight, and ink, not inflated display type.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A shadow appears only if it describes a physically raised object. Nothing in BinVec is physically raised.

dos: Do keep the drawing as the largest, quietest surface in the window.
Do set every value, path, dimension, status, and mode name in mono.
Do show SOURCE and VECTOR at the same scale so the comparison is honest.
Do keep the key scrollable and the title/record strips fixed at 800x600.
Do let the shell go dark while the proof stays paper; the plate is the lit artifact in both modes.
donts: Don't wrap controls in cards or add shadows to separate regions.
Don't use bright teal for small text; use deep teal.
Don't add a second accent for a single widget or state.
Don't use emoji, glyph icons, gradients, glass, or decorative status dots.
Don't hide the current mode, the source file, or the export path behind an interaction.
Don't invert the plate or the trace in dark mode; a black trace on a dark checkerboard is unreadable.
